description: Unofficial fan art of Homura Akemi from Puella Magi Madoka Magica. A fully clothed youthful companion with paper-light gestures, careful clock-card folding, standing hourglass-light review, and three articulated running directions. The left-forearm shield is simplified as a harmless prop; no firearms or combat. Independently drawn original choreography; no affiliation or endorsement.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
